crime_description: Stealing a priceless collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts. Interrogators should probe for connections to an inside accomplice, financial motives, remote burner phone coordination, offshore accounts, and private flight plans.

suspect.name: Liam Nakamura
suspect.fake_alibi: Liam claims he was leading a tour group through a different museum.

secrets.value: An archeologist who smuggled the artifacts out of the excavation site.
Liam plans to sell the artifacts on the black market to fund a lavish lifestyle.
was actively coordinating the crime from a secure burner phone
untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
chartered a private flight under a fake identity
